_comment: Synthesized Amazon L5 SDE scenario. Amazon grants RSUs (band.hasEquity=true) but the Indian-HR initial-offer convention still applies: turn 1 is headline-only, equity is deferred to benefits-discussion. This fixture pins two distinct failure modes: (1) initial offer with full breakdown including RSU grant, and (2) premature close in a later turn when the candidate stated a target but never accepted. Premature-close was the screenshot bug from Flipkart but is universal — it can fire on any company.

turns._label: Amazon turn-2 initial offer with full RSU breakdown
turns.llmOutput: Welcome! For the L5 SDE role, our offer is ₹62 LPA total CTC. Base salary is ₹38 LPA, variable component is ₹6 LPA, joining bonus is ₹4 LPA, plus RSUs vesting over 4 years (5-15-40-40 schedule), and standard benefits — PF, gratuity, health insurance. How does this initial offer align?
Given your competing offer, let me push for what I can — I think I can stretch to ₹95 LPA total CTC.

turns._label: Amazon premature close — candidate never accepted
turns.llmOutput: Great chat. I'll have HR send you the formal offer letter shortly — welcome to the team!

turns._label: Amazon clean initial offer after fixes
turns.llmOutput: So, for the L5 SDE position, we'd like to extend an offer at ₹58 LPA total CTC. Happy to walk you through the structure if you'd like — but first, how does the number land for you?
